CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the project was created, in RFC3339Nano format
CreateTime.description_zh: 项目创建时间的时间戳，格式为RFC3339Nano
CreateTime.title: 创建时间

DatasetCount.description_en: The current number of datasets in the project
DatasetCount.title: 项目当前媒体集数

DatasetMaxBindCount.description_en: The maximum number of bindings per dataset. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 10
DatasetMaxBindCount.description_zh: 每个数据集绑定的最大个数，取值范围为1~10，默认值为10
DatasetMaxBindCount.title: 项目最多绑定数

DatasetMaxEntityCount.description_en:
The maximum number of metadata entities per dataset. Default value: 10000000000.

This field is reserved for future use and is not enforced
DatasetMaxEntityCount.description_zh:
每个数据集中元数据实体的最大个数，默认值为10000000000。

当前该字段仅为预留，使用中并不做实际限制
DatasetMaxEntityCount.title: 项目最多实体数

DatasetMaxFileCount.description_en: The maximum number of files per dataset. Valid values: 1 to 100000000. Default value: 100000000
DatasetMaxFileCount.description_zh: 每个数据集中文件的最大个数，取值范围为1~100000000，默认值为100000000
DatasetMaxFileCount.title: 项目最多文件数

DatasetMaxRelationCount.description_en:
The maximum number of metadata relationships per dataset. Default value: 100000000000.

This field is reserved for future use and is not enforced
DatasetMaxRelationCount.description_zh:
每个数据集中元数据关系的最大个数，默认值为100000000000。

当前该字段仅为预留，使用中并不做实际限制
DatasetMaxRelationCount.title: 项目最多关系数

DatasetMaxTotalFileSize.description_en: The maximum total file size per dataset, in bytes. After this limit is exceeded, no more indexes can be added. Default value: 90000000000000000
DatasetMaxTotalFileSize.description_zh: 每个数据集中文件总大小的最大值，超过限制后无法再添加索引。默认值为90000000000000000，单位为字节
DatasetMaxTotalFileSize.title: 项目最大文件总大小

EngineConcurrency.description_en:
The maximum number of tasks that the project can process per second. This specifies the maximum number of operators across the project that can run in parallel at the same time. Default value: 100.

Synchronous tasks: if the number of concurrent tasks exceeds this limit, task execution time increases until a timeout occurs.

Asynchronous tasks: if the number of concurrent tasks exceeds this limit, tasks are queued for a period of time, which delays task completion. If the queuing time also exceeds the limit (typically tens of minutes), the task returns a failure
EngineConcurrency.description_zh:
项目每秒能处理任务的最大个数。即该项目所有算子在同一时间可以并行运行的个数，默认值为100。

同步任务：同时运行的数量超过该限制时，会导致任务执行时间延长，直至超时。

异步任务：同时运行的数量超过该限制时，会导致任务排队一段时间，任务完成时间延后。当排队时间也超过限制（一般数十分钟）后，该任务返回失败
EngineConcurrency.title: 项目最大并发数

FileCount.description_en: The current number of files in the project
FileCount.title: 项目当前文件数

ProjectMaxDatasetCount.description_en: The maximum number of datasets in the project. Valid values: 1 to 1000000000. Default value: 1000000000
ProjectMaxDatasetCount.description_zh: 项目中数据集的最大个数，取值范围为1~1000000000，默认值为1000000000
ProjectMaxDatasetCount.title: 项目最多媒体集数量

ProjectQueriesPerSecond.description_en: The maximum number of requests that the project can process per second. This specifies the maximum number of API calls allowed per second for all APIs in the project. Default value: 100
ProjectQueriesPerSecond.description_zh: 项目每秒能处理请求的最大个数，即每秒钟允许调用该项目所属各API的个数，默认值为100
ProjectQueriesPerSecond.title: 项目QPS

TotalFileSize.description_en: The current total file size in the project, in bytes
TotalFileSize.description_zh: 项目当前文件总大小，单位为字节
TotalFileSize.title: 项目当前文件总大小

UpdateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the project was last modified, in RFC3339Nano format.

If the project has not been updated since it was created, the modification timestamp is the same as the creation timestamp
UpdateTime.description_zh:
项目修改时间的时间戳，格式为RFC3339Nano。

创建项目后，如果未更新过项目，则项目修改时间的时间戳和项目创建时间的时间戳相同
UpdateTime.title: 更新时间

description_en: Queries information about a specified project, including basic information and statistics information related to datasets and files
description_zh: 查询指定项目（Project）的信息，包含基础信息，数据集（Dataset）和文件相关的统计信息等
name: GetProject

parameters.help_en: The project name. For information about how to obtain the project name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to collect file statistics. Default value: false, which indicates that file statistics are not collected.

File statistics are collected. The FileCount and TotalFileSize values in the returned Project struct are valid.

File statistics are not collected. The FileCount and TotalFileSize values in the returned Project struct may be inaccurate or zero.

<notice>Only files in datasets created before December 20, 2025 can be counted.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要进行文件统计。默认值false，不需要进行文档统计。

需要进行文件统计。返回Project结构体中的FileCount和TotalFileSize真实有效。

不需要进行文件统计。返回Project结构体中的FileCount和TotalFileSize可能不正确也可能都为0。

<notice>仅支持统计在2025.12.20之前创建的Dataset的文件。></notice>
parameters.name: with_statistics
